apps.name: Leap year
apps.purpose: Tells whether a Gregorian year is a leap year. Send a year as decimal digits; it answers leap or common, and invalid request for anything else.
apps.proposition: The year is divisible by 4, and a year divisible by 100 must also be divisible by 400.

apps.name: Legal chess
apps.purpose: Play chess against an app that never accepts or plays an illegal move. Every move goes to the verified holo in your browser; it checks your move against the legal moves of the position, plays it, and answers with its own reply. It looks two moves ahead, so it is a modest opponent.
apps.proposition: If the app plays a move, the verdict on that move, computed by isLegalMove from the rules of movement and king safety, is Legal. Your moves pass through the same verdict before they are played.

apps.name: Luhn check
apps.purpose: Validates a card number with the Luhn check. Send 8 to 19 digits; it answers valid or invalid, and invalid request for anything else.
apps.proposition: From the right, double every second digit, subtract 9 when the double exceeds 9, add everything up. The total is divisible by 10.
